about_the_game:
Upside Down Tales of the Grotesque

Subtitle:​​ She takes the brush to rewrite the world.

Intro:​​

Demons and spirits run rampant in the mortal realm, yet the age-old tales of the grotesque have long silenced vibrant female voices. They wait for salvation, shatter over unfaithful lovers, remain earthbound by doomed passions... But what if heaven and earth reversed? Would the stories unfold differently?

Upside Down Tales of the Grotesques a ​female-oriented classical AVG​ that subverts legendary folklore and flips gender roles, dismantling narratives that confine women to passivity. Here, sheholds the brush, shewields the sword, and sheshatters the chains of fate. Through the eyes of heroines, you'll step into this phantasmagorical world and live their epic tales of love, vengeance, and adventure—all authored by their own hands.

The Art of "Upside Down"​​

・Narrative Reversal: Beyond gender swaps, we amplify women's agency. No longer plot devices, they drive the story with fierce autonomy.

・Destiny Reimagined: Classic tales retain their framework—but their core is reborn. Familiar legends unravel into startling new conclusions.

​Episodic Tales​

Three standalone yet subtly intertwined stories converge in a hidden finale:

・White Serpent​ (based on Legend of the White Snake):

A chance meeting in the rain, an offered umbrella—will this bond between human and spirit become a blessing or a curse?

・Butterfly Upon My Shoulder​ (based on Butterfly Lovers):

Amidst fluttering wings, identity clashes and family feuds threaten her freedom—can she break destiny’s cage?

・Piercing Gaze​ (inspired by Painted Skinand A Chinese Ghost Story):

Spirits weave illusions, masks hide true hearts. With the power to see beyond lies, can she protect what matters most?

・Hidden Finale:

Unlocked after perfect endings! Return to the first-person perspective to unravel clues and uncover the world’s ultimate secret.

​Key Features​

・Classics Remastered: Reimagined folklore brimming with classical elegance and feminist twists.

・Choices with Consequence: Shape each tale’s outcome—discover multiple endings per story.

・Threads of Fate: Seemingly separate tales intertwine, culminating in an explosive finale.

・Immerse in Classical Beauty: Exquisite art and music evoke an ethereal yet haunting Eastern realm.

Follow us for updates.

YingYing Wonders Studio
